principle: UI design is always owned; a separate pre-implementation visual artifact is required only when risk, collaboration cost, or visual sensitivity justifies it.

delivery_modes.purpose: Move quickly on low-risk or exploratory UI through an executable implementation.
Confirm important layout, states, and interaction direction before full implementation.
Use an approved design source for brand-sensitive, high-rework-cost, or multi-party delivery.

tool_policy.selection_rule: Choose the lightest tool that can produce the required evidence for the selected delivery mode.

selection_scope: Record the selected mode in the project-owned UI brief for the work item; a later project profile may define a default.
